title: FORMULATEXT spills an array over multi-cell ranges, returns #N/A for closed workbooks and non-formula cells, and rejects non-reference constants at entry (0x800A03EC)
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, FORMULATEXT(reference) returns #N/A for constant or blank cells, spills a shaped array of formula strings and #N/A over a multi-cell single-area range (e.g. =FORMULATEXT(B2:D4) or =FORMULATEXT(D1#)), returns #SPILL! when a whole-row/whole-column spill such as =FORMULATEXT(C:D) exceeds the sheet, reads only the first area of a multi-area union (=FORMULATEXT((A1,B3)) -> #N/A), returns #N/A when referencing a closed external workbook, and rejects literal numbers or array constants at formula entry (COM 0x800A03EC). All 3,100 full-bank FORMULATEXT rows match.
basis: Measured across all 31 FORMULATEXT cases in CalcFunc-Evidence readings/cell-context/reference-info.json, DnaCalc dc_ylr row 30, and crates/calc-fml/tests/fixtures/entry/excel-entry.tsv; 3,100/3,100 full-bank rows match.
